candidates: Mary Peltola vs Daniel J. Sullivan Jr. (no party label); Gerald Heikes (R) vs Dan S. Sullivan
news_summary: Ex-Rep Peltola outraised Sullivan $36.9M-$14.1M. Oct 28 NYT spoiler-recruitment report, state criminal probe and federal probe landed after most polls.

candidates: Hallie Shoffner vs Jeff Wadlin (L) vs Tom Cotton
news_summary: Farmer Shoffner vs incumbent Cotton; Cotton raised $14.5M vs $4.0M and skipped the Oct 12 debate. No scandals or major late news.

candidates: Angie Nixon vs Neil Gillespie (I) vs Ashley Moody
news_summary: Progressive state Rep. Nixon (beat Vindman) vs appointed Sen. Moody, who has Hope Florida baggage and refused to debate. Moody raised more; Nixon has more cash. Obama endorsed Nixon Oct 24.
Incumbent Ossoff raised $136.6M vs $10.7M for Rep. Mike Collins, whose campaign has been dogged by an ethics probe and staff controversies. Obama rallied Oct 19.

candidates: Josh Turek vs Thomas Laehn (L) vs Ashley Hinson
news_summary: Open seat. State Rep./Paralympian Turek outraised Rep. Hinson $24.3M-$14.1M. Late Turek trans-issues ad drew criticism from LGBTQ group; heavy GOP outside money.

candidates: Adam Hamilton vs David C. Graham (L) vs Roger Marshall
news_summary: Megachurch pastor Hamilton raised $19.2M vs $7.5M for Marshall, hit by NYT patient-lawsuit story. Debated Oct 21. No new October scandal beyond ongoing ad fight.
Open seat after Cassidy lost primary. Rep. Letlow (Trump-backed) vs Tensas Parish police juror Davis. Letlow raised more, Davis more cash. Only Oct poll is a Davis internal.
Ex-Senate President Jackson replaced Platner (withdrew July 10). Fundraising even. Collins' strong personal brand offset by ProPublica pay-to-play story. Four Oct debates.

candidates: Abdul El-Sayed vs Lydia Christensen (L); Douglas Marsh (G); Tim Long (UST); Walter Kristy (NL) vs Mike Rogers
news_summary: Open seat. Progressive first-time candidate El-Sayed (raised $53.8M) vs ex-Rep. Rogers, 2024 near-winner ($23.0M). Three Oct debates; heavy AIPAC spending vs El-Sayed.

candidates: Peggy Flanagan vs Marisa Simonetti (I); Rebecca Whiting (L) vs Michele Tafoya
news_summary: Open seat. Lt. Gov. Flanagan vs ex-sportscaster Tafoya, who raised slightly more and has more cash. Sole debate Oct 16 centered on fraud and Trump. No new scandals.

candidates: Scott Colom vs Ty Pinkins (I) vs Cindy Hyde-Smith
news_summary: Strong DA recruit vs low-profile incumbent who skips debates; Colom near cash parity ($1.0M vs $1.4M COH Oct 14). SMP $1.2M ad, Obama ad, GOP 7-figure buy. Pinkins (I) splits D vote.

candidates: Alani Bankhead vs Seth Bodnar (I); Kyle Austin (L) vs Kurt Alme
news_summary: Scored for Bodnar (I), main non-R (2nd in polls). Split field: D Bankhead stayed in. Oct 12 MT Dem chair resigned to back Bodnar; Tester, Baucus, Buttigieg back him. Alme first-time candidate.
Two-term former governor vs ex-RNC chair never elected; Cooper far ahead on cash (~$20.7M vs $3.4M COH mid-year). No debate agreed; late Oct is GOTV only, no new scandal.
Scored for Osborn (I); D withdrew, party backs him. Proven overperformer vs ex-governor incumbent; Ricketts raised more, Osborn more COH Oct 14. Sept audio leak; Sabato to Lean R Oct 14.

candidates: Chris Pappas vs Edmond Laplante (Constitution) vs John E. Sununu
news_summary: Open seat: US Rep Pappas vs ex-Sen. Sununu, both seasoned. Pappas outraised; COH close (~$3.8M vs $3.0M Sept); SLF pledged $17M for Sununu. No late scandal or debate news.

candidates: Ben Ray Luján vs Larry Marker
news_summary: Incumbent Luján vs Larry Marker, a write-in primary winner with no elected office and no national GOP support; far weaker than a typical R nominee. No notable October news.

candidates: Sherrod Brown vs William Redpath (L) vs Jon Husted
news_summary: Special: ex-3-term Sen. Brown vs appointed Sen. Husted (ex-Lt Gov). Brown outraised him 5 straight quarters; Husted dogged by FirstEnergy ties, $9M green-group ads. No major Oct shock.
Lindsey Graham died July 11; sister Darline (appointed, never elected) won Aug 25 runoff 52.5% over Rep. Norman. Pediatrician Andrews has a large cash edge. Late polls near tied.

candidates: Julian Beaudion (withdrew Aug 4) vs Brian Bengs (I) vs Mike Rounds
news_summary: Scored for Bengs (I), lone challenger after D nominee withdrew Aug 4. Bengs lost 2022 race as a D; Rounds ex-governor incumbent. Rounds COH $1.30M vs $0.07M Oct 14. No major Oct news.
AG Paxton ousted Cornyn but carries major scandals; Talarico raised $64M in Q3 vs ~$18M. Late: Trump calls Paxton 'a little bit controversial', Paxton's impeachment lawyer backs Talarico.

candidates: Bill Hill (I, Dem-backed) vs Nick Begich
news_summary: Begich (inc) vs independent Bill Hill, ex-school superintendent backed by DCCC after Dem Schultz exited; RCV. Begich outraised Hill; Oct reports say Hill gaining ground.
Inc Figures vs state Rep. Marques (Trump/NRCC-backed) in GOP-redrawn seat after Callais. Marques refused debates in Oct; DCCC poll tied. No clear candidate-quality gap.
Inc Hill (Financial Services chair) vs 2022 gov nominee Chris Jones; Harris endorsed Jones, DCCC Red to Blue. Hill leads money. Above-average D recruit vs strong incumbent; net 0.

candidates: Amish Shah vs Monica Alponte (L) vs Jay Feely
news_summary: Open seat (Schweikert ran for gov). Ex-state Rep. Shah (lost 2024 here by 4) vs ex-NFL kicker Feely, Trump-endorsed with celebrity donors. No notable late news.

candidates: Jonathan Nez vs Curtis Goodwin (L) vs Eli Crane
news_summary: Rematch: ex-Navajo Nation president Nez vs inc Crane. Pro-Crane outside groups outspending ~2:1; Oct GOP super PAC ad misidentified Nez. Strong D recruit but repeat; net 0.

candidates: JoAnna Mendoza vs Jereme Peters (L) vs Juan Ciscomani
news_summary: Inc Ciscomani vs Marine/Navy vet Mendoza, who has outraised him (Q2 $2.4M, >2x). GOP hits Mendoza on deleted posts; Dems hit Ciscomani's megabill vote. Net 0.
Inc Gray vs ex-Stockton mayor Lincoln on Prop 50 lines adding Stockton. CLF spent $4.3M+ vs HMP <$0.4M attacking Gray's family-firm ties. Strong R recruit offsets; net 0.
Valadao, durable crossover inc, vs Sanders-backed progressive Villegas (prof, ex-school board) who beat Asm. Bains. Valadao defending Medicaid vote in Oct debate.

candidates: Marni von Wilpert vs Jim Desmond
news_summary: Open (Issa retired), Prop 50 lines. SD councilmember von Wilpert (lives outside district) vs county supervisor/ex-San Marcos mayor Desmond. vW outraised $4.5M to $3M.
Inc Hurd (beat Hanks in primary, Trump-endorsed) vs Aspen Democrat Romero (ex-Aspen councilman, Frisch-backed). Not a national D target; little October news found.
Retired Navy rear admiral Laubacher (ex-GOP) has raised 10x+ Boebert; Trump called for a Boebert primary challenger after she backed Massie; long scandal record. Weak inc.
Inc Crank vs Army vet/ex-Emhoff aide Killin (DCCC Red to Blue), who outraised him through June ($2.7M vs $2.0M). Two debates; no major late news found.
Inc Evans vs state Rep. Rutinel (beat Bird in primary). Sept GOP poll 48-46 Evans. Evans had $3.8M cash post-primary; Dems outraised overall. Both typical; net 0.
Open (Dunn retired). Ex-Rick Scott counsel Rogers won 8-way GOP primary (30%); Dem operations manager Green. Rogers raised $1.36M vs $0.66M. Solid R; no late news.

candidates: LaShonda Holloway vs Mike Sell (Forward); Todd Schaefer (I) vs Aaron Bean
news_summary: Inc Bean vs 3rd-time nominee Holloway on redrawn lines. Bean raised $2.68M vs Holloway $59K (Oct 14). Solid R; nothing notable late.
Inc Cory Mills lost GOP primary to ex-TV anchor Elijah; seat effectively open. DCCC-backed Navy capt/ex-NASA chief of staff Dalton far outraised Elijah ($1.38M vs $0.36M, July).
Inc Soto on DeSantis map: redder, more rural, Hispanic share 50% to 34%. GOP nominee Dan Green, Navy vet and ex-Trump DoD official. Soto cites tied polls; DCCC ~$1M in.

candidates: Kimberly Overman vs Branden Scrivener (NPA) vs Gus Bilirakis
news_summary: Ex-Hillsborough County commissioner Overman (moved into redrawn seat) vs longtime incumbent Bilirakis; above-typical D recruit for a solid-R seat; no notable October news.

candidates: Leela Gray vs Anna Paulina Luna
news_summary: Retired Army Brig. Gen. Gray, strong fundraiser, vs Luna; Gray ads hit Luna over insider-tip allegation (denied); internal and partisan polls show a close race.
20-year incumbent Castor in a redrawn Trump+11 seat vs former state Rep. Beltran; Q2 raised $2.3M vs $2.1M; Tiger Bay forum Oct 16; no scandals found.

candidates: Kelly Kirschner vs Mark Davis (NPA) vs Sydney Gruters
news_summary: Open seat (Buchanan retiring): ex-Sarasota mayor Kirschner vs first-time candidate Gruters (Trump-backed, ex-Buchanan aide, wife of RNC chair). NPA Davis was arrested in July.
Open redrawn seat: ex-White House fellow Dandiya vs wealthy Trump-endorsed businessman Askar; Trump-tied super PAC spent $3.76M vs Dandiya; HMP/Everytown ads; Cook moved to toss-up.
Incumbent Moskowitz (moved into redrawn seat) vs ex-Boca Raton mayor Singer; both experienced. Late: CLF reportedly canceled $6M in planned TV spending in this market.

candidates: Eliott Rodriguez vs Maria Elvira Salazar
news_summary: Ex-Miami TV anchor Rodriguez (narrow primary win) vs incumbent Salazar, who won by ~21 in 2024; DCCC 'District in Play'; no notable October news found.

candidates: Christina Bohannan vs Michael Bridgford (I) vs Mariannette Miller-Meeks
news_summary: Third Bohannan (ex-state rep) vs Miller-Meeks matchup; fundraising roughly even ($7.05M vs $7.21M raised through June); one of the most expensive House races.

candidates: Lindsay James vs Dave Bushaw (I); Rick Stewart (L) vs Joe Mitchell
news_summary: Open seat (Hinson to Senate): Dem state Rep. James vs Trump-endorsed former state Rep. Mitchell; both experienced legislators; no notable October news found.

candidates: Sarah Trone Garriott vs Marco Battaglia (L) vs Zach Nunn
news_summary: State Sen. Trone Garriott (won tough GOP-leaning legislative seats) vs incumbent Nunn; standard strong-recruit matchup; no October scandal or major news found.
Incumbent Mrvan vs Porter County Commissioner Regnitz; both ~$1M cash on hand as of April; Indiana map not redrawn; no notable October news found.
State Sen. Ford, an above-typical recruit, vs erratic incumbent Spartz with a thin war chest; Ford outraised her early; only polling is a Ford internal (Spartz 48-46).
Incumbent Schmidt (former Kansas AG) vs Democrat Don Coover; little coverage found; no notable October news.

candidates: Zach Dembo vs Jay Bowman (I); Pete Lynch (I) vs Ralph Alvarado
news_summary: Open seat: ex-federal prosecutor Dembo vs ex-state Sen. Alvarado. Dembo raised $1.4M in Q3 vs $666K, with $813K vs $359K cash; Sabato moved to Lean R; debate Oct 22.
Open seat (Golden retiring): two-term ex-governor LePage vs state auditor and ex-SoS Dunlap, whom national Dems saw as a weak nominee; debates Oct 1 and Oct 15.

candidates: Sean McCann vs Shafina Che Barnett (G) vs Bill Huizenga
news_summary: State Sen. McCann vs incumbent Huizenga. Huizenga raised $5.56M vs $4.70M, but McCann had $1.03M cash vs $394K on Oct 14. Late RedBox poll: Huizenga 47-44.
Sunrise Movement co-founder Lawrence (no office; weaker swing-seat fit than a typical nominee) vs incumbent Barrett, who outraised him $8.2M to $4.2M. Emerson Oct poll: Lawrence 53-45.

candidates: Christina Hines vs Michael Bouchard Jr.
news_summary: Open seat (James running for gov). Ex-prosecutor Hines vs Army Guard captain Bouchard; Bouchard led raised/cash at July report; Aug D poll tied 45-45; no late scandal.

candidates: Jake Johnson vs Oliver Morlan (I) vs Brad Finstad
news_summary: Teacher Johnson (DCCC Red to Blue) has matched/outraised two-term Rep. Finstad (~$2M each); ex-Finstad adviser backs Johnson. No major late news.
Wagner (7-term) vs podcaster Wellman on GOP-friendlier new map. Wellman outraised Wagner one period but was outspent ~6-1; reports of tightening; Wagner backs Iran war.

candidates: Sam Forstag vs Nick Sheedy (L) vs Aaron Flint
news_summary: Open seat (Zinke retired). Smokejumper Forstag leads raised ($4.3M v $2.8M) and cash thru Oct 14; ex-GOP Gov Racicot backs him; Trump rallied for Flint Oct 14. Cook: toss-up.
Rematch on GOP-redrawn lines. Davis raised $1.3M in Q3 (~$2M cash) and earlier led cash $3.6M v $1.8M; early polls show Davis slightly ahead; ~$5M outside spending.

candidates: Raymond Smith Jr. vs Daniel Cavender (L) vs Greg Murphy
news_summary: Redrawn Trump+14 seat. Ex-state Rep. Smith beat Jaslow in primary; CBC PAC endorsed him, but Murphy holds a large cash lead (~$2.6M vs low-6 figures). No late news.

candidates: Chuck Hubbard vs Robert Luffman (L); David Clayton (I) vs Virginia Foxx
news_summary: Rematch: Foxx beat Hubbard 59.5-40.5 in 2024. Hubbard hitting Foxx for no town halls in a decade. Solid R; no notable late news found.

candidates: Kimberly Hardy vs Maad Abu-Ghazalah (L) vs David Rouzer
news_summary: Rouzer (~$2.3M cash at Q2) skipped Oct 12 UNCW candidate forum and questionnaire; Hardy unopposed for D nod. Solid/likely R; no notable late news.
NRCC chair Hudson vs ex-WV state Sen. Ojeda (DCCC Districts in Play). Hudson leads money (~$4M v $2.2M); Oct 20 PPP poll Hudson 46-42.

candidates: Jamie Ager vs Travis Groo (L); John Rogers (I) vs Jennifer Balkcom
news_summary: Edwards quit in Aug after Ethics report; state Rep. Balkcom picked by committee. Farmer Ager (top D recruit) holds big cash edge ($2.2M v ~$0.3M); 3,000-person Oct 13 rally.
Freshman Knott vs healthcare consultant Barringer; DCCC added seat to Districts in Play in early Oct. Trump won by double digits; no candidate news.

candidates: Chris Backemeyer vs Nik Sandman (L); Daniel Hartong (America First) vs Mike Flood
news_summary: Ex-diplomat Backemeyer vs Rep. Flood; ratings moved to Likely R in Oct; D PPP poll Oct 19-20 Flood 46-45. Nonpartisan Ahlman suspended campaign.

candidates: Denise Powell vs Eric Foreman (L) vs Brinker Harding
news_summary: Open seat (Bacon retired). Powell outraised Harding; cash roughly even (~$1M each, July). CLF pulled $1.1M Omaha ads early Oct; polls Powell +3-5. Oct 15 debate uneventful.
Open seat (Pappas to Senate). Ex-Portsmouth councilor Shaheen vs self-funding businessman DiLorenzo ($1.75M loans). UNH poll statistically tied; both face money questions.

candidates: Zack Mullock vs Jeff Van Drew
news_summary: Cape May Mayor Mullock vs Van Drew; DCCC added seat in early Oct. Van Drew far ahead on cash ($1.5M+ v ~$0.2M); Oct 7-10 Impact (D) poll Van Drew 50-40.

candidates: Rebecca Bennett vs Tom Kean Jr.
news_summary: Navy pilot Bennett vs Kean, who vanished from Congress for months and gave one debate. Bennett outraised him in Q3; Kean had larger cash ($3.4M v $0.76M) plus $4.8M outside help.
Vasquez outraised ex-APD detective Cunningham ($3.8M v $1.5M). Oct polls Vasquez +3/+4; Oct 16 debate even; ~$21.8M total spending. Trump and Speaker Johnson back Cunningham.
Incumbent Titus vs state Sen. Carrie Buck, a credible GOP recruit; Titus holds cash edge. No notable October news found.
Open seat (Amodei retired). Ex-Assembly Majority Leader Benitez-Thompson vs first-time Trump-backed Flippo, who beat Amodei's pick; small sums, D slightly ahead.

candidates: Susie Lee vs Jon Kamerath (IAP) vs Marty O'Donnell
news_summary: Oct 17 AP review: O'Donnell-run 'Marty Army' forum full of slurs and Nazi talk; prior far-right podcast guests. First-time candidate vs well-funded incumbent Lee.
Incumbent Horsford, strong cash position, vs rancher Cody Whipple, a political newcomer. No notable October news.
Incumbent LaLota (~$3M) vs underfunded Black Hawk pilot Chris Gallant (~$81K cash). No notable October news.
Incumbent Garbarino ($2.8M) vs ex-Suffolk County Exec Pat Halpin, 73, with ~$82K cash. No notable October news.
2024 rematch: incumbent Suozzi vs former Assemblyman LiPetri (Trump-endorsed). No notable October news found.
Ex-Rep. D'Esposito dropped out in April; replacement Driscoll (Hempstead tax receiver) raised ~$665K vs Gillen's ~$6M.
Army vet/ex-NSC Conley vs strong-fundraising incumbent Lawler; two debates held (Sept 28, early Oct); Emerson late Sept had Conley +2.
Open seat (Stefanik). Self-funding Sticker Mule CEO Constantino, criticized for conduct; Siena Oct: GOP voters lukewarm. Dairy farmer Gendebien; Dems added money Oct.
Redrawn Trump+11 seat; ex-CIA officer Conroy (Trump-endorsed) vs Landsman. Oct: CLF canceled all remaining ads; Cook/Sabato moved to Likely D.
Since July Miller faces ex-wife's abuse allegations; refused to quit, stuck on ballot; HMP $6M vs him. Union ironworker Poindexter led summer polls incl. a GOP poll.
Rematch: 22-term Kaptur vs ex-state Rep. Merrin on a redrawn, more Republican seat. No notable October news found.
12-term incumbent Turner vs nurse practitioner/Air Force vet Knickerbocker, a first-time candidate. No notable October news found.
Incumbent Carey vs educator Don Leonard, a newcomer who beat ex-state Rep. Adam Miller in the primary. No notable October news.
Bucks Co. Commissioner Harvie (Shapiro-backed) vs well-funded Fitzpatrick; Oct poll Harvie 48-46, Cook moved to Lean R early Oct.
Firefighter union leader Brooks (Shapiro, Jeffries, Sanders backing) vs incumbent Mackenzie, who has a cash edge; F&M Sept poll Brooks 45-40.

candidates: Paige Cognetti vs Eric Stone vs Rob Bresnahan
news_summary: Scranton mayor Cognetti is a top-tier recruit running on anti-corruption vs freshman Bresnahan, dogged by stock-trade criticism; Bresnahan held modest cash edge midyear; $10M+ outside spending.
Rematch: ex-TV anchor Stelson (lost by ~5,100 in 2024) beat Justin Douglas in primary and has outraised Perry; no major new October developments found.

candidates: Nancy Lacore vs Jenny Costa Honeycutt
news_summary: Open seat (Mace ran for governor). Retired 3-star admiral Lacore raised $1.6M+ by June, far ahead of GOP field; Trump-endorsed Honeycutt won GOP runoff. No October news found.

candidates: Justin Pearson vs Dennis Clark (I); Michelle Head (I) vs Brent Taylor
news_summary: Redrawn Trump+21 seat (Cohen retired). Oct 27 Nashville Scene report: GOP state Sen. Taylor sent unsolicited nude photos; he admitted it. Late, after most early voting.

candidates: Leticia Gutierrez vs Roy Morales (I, unconfirmed) vs Alex Mealer
news_summary: Redrawn GOP-leaning Hispanic-majority Houston seat. Trump-backed Mealer beat Briscoe Cain in runoff; UH poll Oct 3-7: Mealer 48, Gutierrez 42. Gutierrez has low name ID.

candidates: Bobby Pulido vs Monica De La Cruz
news_summary: Tejano music star Pulido is an unusually strong local-fit recruit vs incumbent De La Cruz; recent polls show Pulido ahead; Cook moved race to Toss Up in late Sept.

candidates: Katy Padilla Stout vs Ben Mendoza (I) vs Brandon Herrera
news_summary: Open seat after Rep. Tony Gonzales resigned over affair. GOP nominee is YouTuber 'AK Guy' Herrera, under fire for crude online remarks; Dem is first-time candidate, DCCC target.
Webb Co. Judge Tijerina (ex-Democrat) vs Cuellar on GOP-redrawn map. Oct 14: GOP super PAC CLF pulled $3M in reserved ads, shifting it to TX-15/TX-34; Aug TSU poll Cuellar +11.
Incumbent Gonzalez vs Army veteran Eric Flores, who beat ex-Rep. Mayra Flores in primary. Gonzalez leads in money; CLF shifted ad money into the race in October.

candidates: Johnny Garcia vs Carlos De La Cruz
news_summary: Redrawn GOP-leaning San Antonio-area seat; both political newcomers: ex-sheriff's deputy Garcia (moderate) vs Trump-backed Air Force vet De La Cruz (brother of Rep. Monica De La Cruz).
VA redraw struck down; 2021 lines used. Henrico Commonwealth's Attorney Taylor vs longtime Rep. Wittman, who holds the larger war chest; heavy early voting.

candidates: Elaine Luria vs Makiba Gaines (I); Bishop Staten (I) vs Jen Kiggans
news_summary: Third Luria-Kiggans matchup; former two-term Rep. Luria is a stronger-than-typical challenger and on DCCC Red to Blue; Kiggans holds cash-on-hand edge. 2021 lines.

candidates: Tom Perriello vs Cooke Costa Harvey (I) vs John McGuire
news_summary: Former Rep. Perriello has ~2-to-1 cash edge and outraised McGuire ($3.5M vs $2.2M); WaPo-Schar Sept poll McGuire 51-45. 2021 lines (redraw struck down).

candidates: Marie Gluesenkamp Perez vs John Braun
news_summary: GOP recruited state Senate Minority Leader Braun (Navy vet, Trump-endorsed), much stronger than past nominee Joe Kent; MGP faces progressive discontent; top-two primary nearly tied.
Rematch of 2024: first-term Rep. Baumgartner vs former diplomat and prosecutor Conroy; October forum focused on tariffs, Medicaid cuts, data centers. No major late news.
ER nurse and first-time candidate Berman vs Steil, who has raised ~$6.3M to Berman's ~$1.3M; Sabato moved race to Lean R; DCCC Red to Blue.

candidates: Rebecca Cooke vs Derrick Van Orden
news_summary: Rematch of 2024 (Van Orden +2.7). Van Orden raised ~$6.6M vs Cooke ~$5.3M; Oct 20 debate; Speaker Johnson campaigned for him Oct 7. No major late shift found.
